svg.aria-label: Day 1 hero: an eco-lodge on stilts in a green rainforest valley beside a turquoise bay. A whale shark swims under a small boat, a sea turtle rises to the surface, hikers cross a rope bridge and a plane leaves a vapour trail in the sky. Floating cards show Sustainable Development Goal badges 2 and 3, an essay page split into coloured parts, and headphones with a sound wave.
svg.title: Week 4 Day 1: eco-tourism — unpack, read, listen
